title: Fruit Into Baskets
description:
Given `fruits`, where each value is a fruit type on a row of trees, choose a starting tree and collect one fruit from each consecutive tree moving right. You have two baskets, each holding one fruit type. Return the maximum number of fruits you can collect.

## Examples

```text
Input: fruits = [1,2,1]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: fruits = [1,2,3,2,2]
Output: 4
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= fruits.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= fruits[i] < fruits.length`
